name: Shinomiya Kyo
source:
The only other person who traveled back in time with the protagonist. It's rumored that he looks exactly like a Shinsen-gumi member who has disappeared. He is the protagonist's friend from her college days, and his cheeky attitude is surprisingly popular. He's never had a girlfriend.

[Edited from [url=https://www.cyikemen.com/DestinedToLove/pc/index.html]official website[/url]]
